input: Find STEM, science, coding, academic, cooking and enrichment summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Waynesville, Canton, Clyde, Maggie Valley and Lake Junaluska, NC (Haywood County). Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Haywood County summer camps 2026 STEM science cooking kids
Waynesville summer 2026 kids coding cooking camp

candidates.name: Haywood Community College
candidates.note: 2026 Bobcat College served rising grades 6–8 with STEM, biology, healthcare, forensics, creative arts and survival skills.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension, Haywood County 4-H
candidates.note: 2026 Summer Fun included electricity and space STEM, Farm to Fork cooking, sewing, crochet, evening crafts and archery.

candidates.name: Pigeon Community Multicultural Development Center
candidates.note: Nine-week Summer Enrichment Program for K–12 combines reading, math, STEAM, music, arts and field trips.

candidates.name: Haywood County Soil and Water Conservation District
candidates.note: YES Camp is a one-week environmental-science day camp for rising grades 8–9, with conservation activities and regional field trips.

candidates.name: Haywood County Public Library
candidates.note: 2025–2026 summer programming included reading enrichment, children's art activities and a dinosaur-fossil science workshop.

candidates.name: Smoky Mountain Sk8way & Fun Zone
candidates.note: Summer day camp combines STEAM experiments, culinary activities, crafts, skating, games and local outings; 2027 page is posted.

candidates.name: Town of Waynesville Parks and Recreation
candidates.note: 2026 Summer Basecamp offered rising PreK–8 children full-day summer enrichment with crafts, outdoor activities and regional exploration.

candidates.name: Town of Canton Parks and Recreation
candidates.note: Summer day camp at Recreation Park offers weekly themes, crafts, games and swimming, grouped by rising grade.

candidates.name: Haywood County Schools
candidates.note: School-based summer childcare includes Bethel Elementary's June–August 2026 day camp and Jonathan Valley Elementary's summer camp.
